analytics.name: Analytic 2048
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies successful authentication to Windows-hosted Industrial Control System (ICS) applications using credentials matching known default or hardcoded vendor passwords. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.

analytics.name: Analytic 2219
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies successful authentication to an Industrial Control System (ICS) device or application using credentials that are either documented vendor defaults (T1694.001) or extracted from configuration files/firmware where stored in cleartext (T1694.002), from a source not in the approved access list. This technique-level analytic unifies both sub-techniques. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the account/device/session violates the approved identity + source host/jump path/zone policy and is corroborated by access to a protected OT asset, execution, configuration change, or another security-relevant follow-on event. Suppress approved shift activity, vendor support, break-glass use, commissioning, and documented remote-access windows.
